g.text: Title: Open-sEMG-16 USB / Wi-Fi bench prototype

g.desc: Title: Open-sEMG-16 USB / Wi-Fi bench prototype

g.text: Simulated signals only - no human connection with laptop USB

g.desc: Simulated signals only - no human connection with laptop USB

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Reference / internal bypass nodes: separate per ADC; never join VCAPs.

g.desc: Reference / internal bypass nodes: separate per ADC; never join VCAPs.

g.text: VREFP: 10uF || 100nF to VREFN/GND; enable internal 2.4V reference.

g.desc: VREFP: 10uF || 100nF to VREFN/GND; enable internal 2.4V reference.

g.text: VCAP3 is about5.2V on3.3V supply: >=10V rated, bias-qualified parts.

g.desc: VCAP3 is about5.2V on3.3V supply: >=10V rated, bias-qualified parts.

g.text: Input pairs: 2k per leg (0.1%, >=0.1W), 620pF to GND (C0G,1%).

g.desc: Input pairs: 2k per leg (0.1%, >=0.1W), 620pF to GND (C0G,1%).

g.text: Preserved RC topology; no added human-contact protection.

g.desc: Preserved RC topology; no added human-contact protection.

g.text: Unused PACE/RLDIN17/18/62 tied to AVDD: keep PACE/rerouting OFF.

g.desc: Unused PACE/RLDIN17/18/62 tied to AVDD: keep PACE/rerouting OFF.

g.text: GPIO1-4, DAISY_IN and RESV1 grounded; configure GPIO1-4 as inputs.

g.desc: GPIO1-4, DAISY_IN and RESV1 grounded; configure GPIO1-4 as inputs.

g.text: USB/DevKit nominal capacity supports the calculated load; actual board/regulator and USB current authorization must be checked.

g.desc: USB/DevKit nominal capacity supports the calculated load; actual board/regulator and USB current authorization must be checked.

g.text: Wi-Fi TX current355mA is a typical characterized peak, not a worst-case system guarantee; verify rail droop, heat and noise.

g.desc: Wi-Fi TX current355mA is a typical characterized peak, not a worst-case system guarantee; verify rail droop, heat and noise.

g.text: No external analog source before rails are valid. Begin with ADC internal-short/test mux, then a grounded simulator near1.65V common mode.

g.desc: No external analog source before rails are valid. Begin with ADC internal-short/test mux, then a grounded simulator near1.65V common mode.

g.text: At gain6 and2.4V reference: |VD|<0.4V and0.2+G|VD|/2<VCM<3.3-0.2-G|VD|/2. Keep each pin within supply rails; resistor is not a clamp.

g.desc: At gain6 and2.4V reference: |VD|<0.4V and0.2+G|VD|/2<VCM<3.3-0.2-G|VD|/2. Keep each pin within supply rails; resistor is not a clamp.

g.text: Direct ESP->ADS published VIH/VOH limits meet only at0.8xVDD; loaded HIGH margin and startup ramps require scope verification.

g.desc: Direct ESP->ADS published VIH/VOH limits meet only at0.8xVDD; loaded HIGH margin and startup ramps require scope verification.

g.text: Keep RF/high-current returns away from ADC input/reference loops. F07/F08 body bias, wearer protection and isolation remain outside this bench revision.

g.desc: Keep RF/high-current returns away from ADC input/reference loops. F07/F08 body bias, wearer protection and isolation remain outside this bench revision.

g.text: HR mode2kSPS nominal: CONFIG1 HR=1, DR=100, both ADCs.

g.desc: HR mode2kSPS nominal: CONFIG1 HR=1, DR=100, both ADCs.

g.text: SPI mode1, short traces; verify measured loaded logic/edges.

g.desc: SPI mode1, short traces; verify measured loaded logic/edges.

g.text: Example Wi-Fi:10 pairs +16B header/UDP =116.8kB/s at IP layer.

g.desc: Example Wi-Fi:10 pairs +16B header/UDP =116.8kB/s at IP layer.

g.text: Use SPI DMA, separate Wi-Fi task, ring buffer, sequence IDs.

g.desc: Use SPI DMA, separate Wi-Fi task, ring buffer, sequence IDs.

g.text: Bounded RF outages need buffering/retry; no lossless claim tested.

g.desc: Bounded RF outages need buffering/retry; no lossless claim tested.

g.text: 10k pulldowns retain LOW while MCU high-Z (also DIN/SCLK).

g.desc: 10k pulldowns retain LOW while MCU high-Z (also DIN/SCLK).

g.text: Boot/warm reset: initialize LOW forward latches; CS both HIGH;

g.desc: Boot/warm reset: initialize LOW forward latches; CS both HIGH;

g.text: release PWDN, allow rails/VCAP/POR, reset ADC1, enable CLK_EN.

g.desc: release PWDN, allow rails/VCAP/POR, reset ADC1, enable CLK_EN.

g.text: U1CLKSEL=HIGH, U2CLKSEL=LOW; U1CLK drives both CLK pins.

g.desc: U1CLKSEL=HIGH, U2CLKSEL=LOW; U1CLK drives both CLK pins.

g.text: Allow slave POR on valid clock; reset/configure U2; shared START.

g.desc: Allow slave POR on valid clock; reset/configure U2; shared START.

g.text: Reinitialize after PWDN/reset: CLK_EN and reference settings reset.

g.desc: Reinitialize after PWDN/reset: CLK_EN and reference settings reset.

g.text: TI11.1 low-input ramp wording vs CS pullups needs bench review.

g.desc: TI11.1 low-input ramp wording vs CS pullups needs bench review.

g.text: CS1=GPIO21 / CS2=GPIO39: HIGH at boot; select ONE ADC only.

g.desc: CS1=GPIO21 / CS2=GPIO39: HIGH at boot; select ONE ADC only.

g.text: DOUT is high-Z with CS HIGH (TI9.4.2.1). No external MISO gate.

g.desc: DOUT is high-Z with CS HIGH (TI9.4.2.1). No external MISO gate.

g.text: Use GPIO mux, disable pad JTAG; verify eFuses before assembly.

g.desc: Use GPIO mux, disable pad JTAG; verify eFuses before assembly.

g.text: GPIO3 HIGH selects USB JTAG only in strap-controlled modes.

g.desc: GPIO3 HIGH selects USB JTAG only in strap-controlled modes.

g.text: OPEN-sEMG-16 V1.4 | USB power / Wi-Fi data | 16 x 24-bit channels at target 2 kSPS

g.desc: OPEN-sEMG-16 V1.4 | USB power / Wi-Fi data | 16 x 24-bit channels at target 2 kSPS

g.text: BENCH ONLY: simulated, non-human-connected signals. Never attach a person while laptop USB is connected.

g.desc: BENCH ONLY: simulated, non-human-connected signals. Never attach a person while laptop USB is connected.

g.text: USB supplies power/programming/debug; acquisition frames go over built-in Wi-Fi. Firmware and hardware remain untested.

g.desc: USB supplies power/programming/debug; acquisition frames go over built-in Wi-Fi. Firmware and hardware remain untested.

g.text: Use a complete stock DevKitC-1, not a bare module.

g.desc: Use a complete stock DevKitC-1, not a bare module.

g.text: Laptop USB -> onboard regulator -> 3V3 header pins1/2.

g.desc: Laptop USB -> onboard regulator -> 3V3 header pins1/2.

g.text: No battery, external regulator or other3V3 source.

g.desc: No battery, external regulator or other3V3 source.

g.text: 5V and CHIP_PU header branches have no carrier connection;

g.desc: 5V and CHIP_PU header branches have no carrier connection;

g.text: onboard USB, reset, boot and UART circuits remain in DevKit.

g.desc: onboard USB, reset, boot and UART circuits remain in DevKit.

g.text: Reference / internal bypass nodes: separate per ADC; never join VCAPs.

g.desc: Reference / internal bypass nodes: separate per ADC; never join VCAPs.

g.text: VREFP: 10uF || 100nF to VREFN/GND; enable internal 2.4V reference.

g.desc: VREFP: 10uF || 100nF to VREFN/GND; enable internal 2.4V reference.

g.text: VCAP3 is about5.2V on3.3V supply: >=10V rated, bias-qualified parts.

g.desc: VCAP3 is about5.2V on3.3V supply: >=10V rated, bias-qualified parts.

g.text: Input pairs: 2k per leg (0.1%, >=0.1W), 620pF to GND (C0G,1%).

g.desc: Input pairs: 2k per leg (0.1%, >=0.1W), 620pF to GND (C0G,1%).

g.text: Preserved RC topology; no added human-contact protection.

g.desc: Preserved RC topology; no added human-contact protection.

g.text: Unused PACE/RLDIN17/18/62 tied to AVDD: keep PACE/rerouting OFF.

g.desc: Unused PACE/RLDIN17/18/62 tied to AVDD: keep PACE/rerouting OFF.

g.text: GPIO1-4, DAISY_IN and RESV1 grounded; configure GPIO1-4 as inputs.

g.desc: GPIO1-4, DAISY_IN and RESV1 grounded; configure GPIO1-4 as inputs.

g.text: AVDD local DVDD local AVDD1 local

g.desc: AVDD local DVDD local AVDD1 local

g.text: Route each bypass at its pins; star AVDD1/AVSS1 to AVDD/AVSS.

g.desc: Route each bypass at its pins; star AVDD1/AVSS1 to AVDD/AVSS.

g.text: All three domains use the SAME DevKit 3.3V rail and common return.

g.desc: All three domains use the SAME DevKit 3.3V rail and common return.

g.text: AVDD local DVDD local AVDD1 local

g.desc: AVDD local DVDD local AVDD1 local

g.text: Route each bypass at its pins; star AVDD1/AVSS1 to AVDD/AVSS.

g.desc: Route each bypass at its pins; star AVDD1/AVSS1 to AVDD/AVSS.

g.text: All three domains use the SAME DevKit 3.3V rail and common return.

g.desc: All three domains use the SAME DevKit 3.3V rail and common return.
